text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal Record (Issued by the local police station) * 2. The Certified/Notarized Copy of High School Diploma Diploma in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 3. The Certified/Notarized Copy of High School Transcripts Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 4. Financial Guarantee Letter (The certificate of bank saving) * 5. Personal Statement/Study Plan You can download a template or sample from here . * 6. Physical Examination Record for Foreigner Please go to hospital for a physical examination. You can download a template or sample from here . 7. Other documents Students in design major should provide no less than 2 art works. * 8. The Photocopy of Passport (photo page and China visa page) * 9. ID photo with white background. * 10. English Language test result * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
